query:
SELECT 
            gm.id,
            gm.user_id,
            u.display_name,
            u.avatar_url,
            gm.role,
            gm.joined_at
        FROM group_members gm
        JOIN users u ON u.id = gm.user_id
        WHERE gm.group_id = $1
        ORDER BY 
            CASE gm.role
                WHEN 'owner' THEN 1
                WHEN 'admin' THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END,
            gm.joined_at
